## The campfire got a lot more going on

The **FIRE** background was mostly a heat grid and some embers. It now has weather, lighting, a tree with a resident, and something you can summon.

**The fire itself.** The flames lean and gust — the old propagation drifted each cell symmetrically, so the fire had no net direction at any moment, which is most of why it read as an effect rather than a fire. Colour banding in the flame body is dithered out along the heat ramp, the cool fringe dies faster so tongues separate instead of blurring into one another, and embers now spawn at an actual flame rather than anywhere along the ground. There are logs at the base that glow with the fire, so the flames come off something instead of rising out of the bottom edge.

**A dead tree with an owl in it**, standing behind the fire — genuinely behind, meaning the flames are drawn over it a pixel at a time rather than it faking occlusion. The owl blinks, and every thirty seconds it has something to say.

**And if you tap the moon ten times, a werewolf turns up.** The moon waxes from crescent toward full as the taps land, so you can tell it's working. It arrives eyes-first out of the dark, holds, howls, and fades back. The owl notices.

**Also**: the browser emulator now runs at the device's real 33fps instead of your monitor's refresh rate — the backgrounds are paced by frame count, so on a 120Hz laptop they were running nearly four times too fast. And the flasher page has a **TRY IT NOW** badge up top, because the emulator link was previously buried in the footer text past where most people stop reading.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: browser emulator ran at monitor refresh, so every animation played several times too fast
- **Added**: werewolf easter egg on the FIRE background — ten taps on the moon
- **Added**: owl in the tree, with something to say every thirty seconds
- **Changed**: FIRE reworked — wind, dithered flame body, firelit logs, tighter tongues, embers that come from the flames
- **Changed**: the tree behind the fire is a real silhouette now, occluded by draw order rather than a per-frame test that made it strobe
- **Added**: TRY IT NOW badge linking to the emulator from the top of the flasher page
